_comment: Quest threads (the player's Notes). Stage 0 = not started. Each stage: note, advance conditions, on_enter effects, optional branch. Notes are written as the player's own shorthand.

stages.note: The town well gives nothing. Someone in a brass helmet is fighting it.
Barnaby says the Lease at the west end is empty. Look around it.
Seeds, a tiller, an empty can. The well is still dry. Barnaby's been tracing the line.
Hold the plumb-glass up at the well [C]. Look at the ground the way the pipe sees it.
The well line has burst under the lane. Mend it with seal gum, then crank the well.
Water in the basin. Real water.
Till the plots by the Lease and plant the glowbeet seeds. Glowbeets like it warm, wet and lit.
Keep them watered. Lamps and glowroots help; sour air doesn't.
Glowbeets! Sell a few at the Exchange, or keep them for something better.
Your first harvest is on someone's table tonight.
Nothing refills the cistern since the Station pump died. Put a pump down in the Sink and pipe it to the cistern outlet.
The pump needs power. Odile sells burners. Hesper swears by the spring. Barnaby has a crank and opinions.
Water climbs to the cistern again. Whatever is making that power, people will notice it.
The Reach gate is open. Brass scrap, glowglass and blackstone lie below. Be home by Hush.
Someone built things down here once. Find a ruin and see what they left.
A Station 7 crew log, in a ruin a long way from Station 7.
Barnaby wants you to look at the Station pump. Just look. Use the glass in the pump hall.
The pump needs a governor coil and four seal gum. Barnaby says the only coil is in the Trunk chamber, past a passage that's been sealed for years.
The Tremor broke the seal. The Trunk chamber in the Reach is open. Find the governor coil.
Fit the governor coil and four seal gum to the Station pump, then give it fifty-five power.
Station 7 is breathing. Barnaby is standing very still in the pump hall.
Meet Barnaby at the Trunk valve, in the Sink beneath the pump hall. Through the glass.
Three. Two. Three.
A brass tag from a crew locker under the lane: W. ASKEW — TRUNK CREW. It's warm. Barnaby might know the name.
Wren Askew was down-line when Barnaby closed the Trunk valve. She knocked for an hour.
A note in Wren's hand, in the Trunk chamber. Eleven years old. 'Don't wait up.'
The Tremor split the ground under the Lease. Sour gas is climbing out of the old pocket. Pack the fissure with blackstone, scrub the air, or lose the plots.
The fissure is packed. The air over the farm is clearing.
On the fifth night Wick puts out every lamp to watch the grove bloom. Hesper and Odile disagree about the market lamps.
The grove bloomed so bright the lake held it twice. Hesper cried, efficiently.
The bloom came up thin. Nobody said why out loud. Everybody knew.
Odile wants to sell water and beets down-river for medicine before the damp season. She needs twenty glowbeets in the Exchange's stock.
The first trade crate went down-river. Odile wrote a number in the ledger and underlined it twice.
Knock from the pipe-heads in the lane, at Hush. Three-two-three: still here.
Answers take the long way round. Back to the pipe-heads tomorrow, at Hush.
Someone below answers in crew code. Keep the conversation going: one knock a night, at Hush.
Bad air. Bad air. Help. Ask them what they want.
Two-two, four. No. Come.
Mags has called everyone to the Lantern House at Dimming. Everyone.
Wick has talked it over. Mags wrote it on the board, in chalk.
Plait two lengths of crew cable at a bench: four moss fibre and two brass each.
Under the pump hall, through the glass: fit the cable and six brass to the winch, then feed it thirty power.
The Primary Lift runs. The cage waits at the bottom of the shaft. Ride it down from the pump hall.
Station 8. Down here the air tastes older than the rock.
Follow the Lower Stations down. Somewhere at the bottom, someone is knocking.
Pell says Wren Askew is alive, and ill, in the last shack by the Heart door.
Read the archive in Sallow's hall. Find out what the Quiet was.
Barnaby needs to hear about Wren. From you.
Barnaby knows. Whatever he does next is his.
Wren has the damp cough, and a few days, she says. Moss tincture from Hesper, or Odile's down-river medicine, might help.
Wren is breathing all the way down. She's furious about it.
Wren died in the night, asking for Barnaby. Pell has her journal.
Barnaby has ridden the lift down. Give him an hour. Then go after him.
She told him to stop that face. He hasn't. It's a different face now.
Barnaby added one mark to the chalk wall. Still here.
The lake breathes out and the children cough. Odile has a new column in the ledger.
Odile's down-river trade could bring medicine before the worst of it: twenty glowbeets through the Exchange.
Medicine came up the chute. Bark, honey, and a dosing card in a careful hand.
Hesper's moss was made: Strain Seven, to eat the damp cough. She might steep it into a tincture, if the frames are healthy and the air is clean.
Moss tincture: three fibres, one bellcap and a cup of moss tea, at the bench. It tastes of the frames after rain.
Mags is short for the damp season. Six jars of salted beets would let her stop doing sums in her sleep. Salt lies in the deep flats.
Six jars glowing on the Lantern House shelf.
The Old Stone wants to hear a walker. Grist says the Knapper Ways open off the deepest Blackstone cavern.
The Old Stone's terms: quiet rock above the Reach, and three glowglass, so the Knappers know walkers still make light.
The agreement is kept. The Knappers are opening the low ways to the Heart door.
Tolley Brand, the Lease's old tenant, is at Sallow apologising to fungus. He would like to go home, and is afraid to say so.
Tolley is back on the Lease cot and has taken the morning watering.
The Knappers opened the low ways. The Heart door at Sallow stands open.
The Heart needs pressure (Barnaby: the Trunk valve open, the Station pump fed), clean air (Hesper: tincture or a scrubber, nothing sour), and Wick's yes (Mags).
Wick says yes. Everyone goes down to the Heart. Meet them at the console.
The Heart is decided.
Mags has called a second meeting at Dimming: open every Trunk and restart the Heart, or not. Everyone votes.
Wick voted.
Below the Heart, a stair goes on into the Unmapped. Nobody has a map. Nobody ever will.
Three stations below the bottom of everything, and the stair keeps going.
